title: Bench Standard: the Amount a Guest Bears for a Damage Finding on Equipment Rental and Demo Kit
content:
## The order of the working

An item of hire kit a technician has found fault with is assessed against the agreement it was hired on, one assessment for each item, and the amount the guest bears is worked out in the order set out here.

**First, the amount the finding carries.** The amount the finding carries is the heavy use share of the package's replacement value, rounded half up to two decimal places. The heavy use share is 10 per cent. The replacement value is the one held against the package of the Equipment Rental and Demo line the kit was hired on.

**Second, the two set-asides.** Nothing is set aside for the kit having been taken out of the shop's sight. Nothing is set aside for a technician having had the kit in hand part-way through the hire.

**Third, what is carried to the cover step.** The whole of what is then left is carried to the cover step.

**Fourth, the cover step.** The guest bears the full cover share of the amount left. The full cover share is 20 per cent.

**How the steps meet one another.** Every set-aside and every share in the steps set out here acts on the amount left after the step before it, and the amount left is rounded half up to two decimal places at each of those steps.

**Last.** The figure the guest bears is taken as it stands, rounded half up to two decimal places. The figure the guest bears is never below zero.

Fair wear on edges and bases is not charged, and kit that never comes back is charged at the package's replacement value rather than assessed under this rule.

## The working on a hypothetical finding

Take a finding entered by a technician against one item hired on a package whose replacement value is 890.00 USD.

| Step | Working | Amount left after the step |
| --- | --- | --- |
| the amount the finding carries | 10 per cent of 890.00 USD, rounded half up to two decimal places | 89.00 USD |
| taken out of the shop's sight | nothing set aside, so the step leaves what it started from | 89.00 USD |
| in a technician's hands part-way through | nothing set aside, so the step leaves what it started from | 89.00 USD |
| carried to the cover step | the whole of what the step before it left | 89.00 USD |
| the cover step | 20 per cent of the 89.00 USD that step left | 17.80 USD |
| the figure the guest bears | taken as it stands, rounded half up to two decimal places, and never below zero | 17.80 USD |

The same working on a package whose replacement value is 420.00 USD gives 42.00 USD at the first step and 8.40 USD as the figure the guest bears.

## Points of judgement

**Each step starts from what the last one left.** No step is measured against the amount the finding first carried; each takes the amount the step before it left, and that amount is rounded half up to two decimal places as each step ends.

**Two items faulted on one agreement.** There is one assessment for each item, so each item is worked through this rule on its own against the same agreement.

**A finding on kit that shows fair wear on its edges and bases.** Fair wear on edges and bases is not charged.

**Kit that never came back at all.** Such kit is charged at the package's replacement value; it is not worked through this rule.

**A figure that would come out below nothing.** The figure the guest bears is never below zero.
